title: Reporting path with InformationReport then Conclude-Error-PDU
purpose: Add explicit reporting-path diversity by sending an Unconfirmed-PDU analogue for InformationReport before exercising Conclude-Error-PDU, satisfying the request to diversify reporting coverage rather than keeping four nearly identical terminal-tag frames.
expected_behavior: The unconfirmed reporting-style frame should exercise a different MMS PDU family from confirmed and cancel traffic, and the concluding error PDU should then reach the documented Conclude-Error-PDU parser entry point. Parser stability and bounded processing are expected even if session semantics are incomplete.
constraints_preserved: TPKT total-length fields are consistent with the complete message.
Reporting-path diversity is added using an Unconfirmed-PDU analogue before conclude-error coverage.
MMS PDU type tags remain aligned with documented values including 0xa3 and 0xad.
No exact historical crash payload or duplicate prior seed is reused.
issue_safety_notes: This seed is a safe parser-path expansion only. It does not include dangerous TPDU-size exponents, negative octet-string size patterns, or oversized nested lengths.
